hero.intro: KWIIN brings award winning Thai Massage and real rest directly to you.
home.beliefIntro: Luxury does not have to be loud.
home.touchCopy: Massage is a direct form of care. A good treatment listens to your body and gives it what it needs today.
home.touchFinalOne: We do not only treat muscles.
home.thaiCopy: Nuad Thai combines pressure, stretching, and calm movement. UNESCO recognised it as cultural heritage in 2019. Pratana carries on this tradition with respect and experience.
home.testimonialOne: I have met many therapists. With Pratana, I noticed straight away how experienced and attentive she is.
home.testimonialTwo: I love her deep tissue work. I feel so much lighter every time.
home.testimonialThree: Very warm, professional, and respectful. I feel like new after every treatment.
home.inviteCopy: Let go of the day without having to travel anywhere. Pratana brings your time out to you.
home.inviteWelcome: KWIIN Mobile Spa comes to you.
values.aria: Our values: elegance, quality, mindfulness, respect, and authenticity.
mobile.heroCopy: Pratana brings the massage table, oils, and fresh towels to your home, office, or hotel.
mobile.homeCopy: Enjoy your massage in a familiar place. You do not need to travel afterwards.
mobile.officeCopy: Massage on site for individuals, teams, and long working days.
mobile.hotelCopy: Pratana comes directly to your hotel room or private suite in the Zurich region.
mobile.prepareCopy: Almost nothing. A quiet room and a comfortable temperature are enough.
mobile.rangeCopy: Travel costs CHF 45 up to 15 km and CHF 100 up to 30 km. Ask us about longer distances.
mobile.endQuote: The same personal care, right where you are.
services.copy: Choose travel up to 15 km or up to 30 km. Every price updates at once and shows the full total in Swiss francs.
service.kwiin.tagline: Strong, focused, and adapted to you.
service.kwiin.description: Pratana's personal Signature massage combines Thai massage, stretching, and pressure point work. It helps with deep tension and supports movement.
service.booster.description: Focused deep tissue work for sport, training, and physical strain. It loosens tight muscles and supports recovery.
service.flow.tagline: Calm, light movements for your body.
service.flow.description: A gentle, rhythmic massage using techniques for lymph flow. Good for anyone who wants a slow and deeply relaxing treatment.
service.back.tagline: Focused help for your back, neck, and shoulders.
service.back.description: A focused treatment for tension caused by stress, desk work, or physical strain.
service.crown.tagline: A clear head and deep rest.
service.crown.description: A pleasant head massage for relaxation, calmer sleep, and a lighter feeling.
service.bata.tagline: Relaxation from your feet to your head.
service.bata.description: A relaxing foot massage with pressure point techniques. It helps you switch off and gives your body a calm feeling.
pricing.zoneCopy: Travel is included in the total price

about.intro: Pratana's journey started in Bangkok and led through Germany to Switzerland.
about.storyCopy: KWIIN grew from experience, a lot of practice, and a love for Thai massage. Pratana combines her roots with a calm and personal service.
about.nameCopy: KWIIN comes from King, Queen, and Win. The name is a reminder that everyone deserves respect and good care.
about.nameNote: No matter who you are or where you come from.
about.pillarCareNote: We listen and take our time.
about.philosophyCopy: We want you to feel safe, understood, and well looked after.
about.philosophyQuote: Every treatment is personal. Every body needs something different.
about.visionCopy: Rest matters. An appointment at KWIIN should simply feel good and give you time to switch off.
about.valueEleganceNote: Calm massage in your own space.
about.valueQualityNote: Award-winning Thai massage at your place.
about.valueRespectNote: Your privacy and comfort come first.
about.valueAuthenticityNote: Authentic Thai massage backed by experience.
about.founderCopyOne: Pratana was born in Bangkok in 1990 and grew up in Thailand and Germany. As a teenager, she started by massaging her mother. She soon noticed that she had a special feel for pressure and movement.
about.founderCopyTwo: Later, she developed her craft in Germany and Switzerland. Today she brings her personal Thai massage to people across the Zurich region as KWIIN Mobile Spa.
about.awardsTitle: Four medals for experience and precise technique.
about.awardsCopy: In 2026, Pratana won four medals at the Nordic Nuad Thai Massage Championship in Finland. They included gold in Thai massage and sports massage.
about.inviteCopy: Pratana listens first and adapts every treatment to what you want. Just ask if you are not sure which massage suits you.
about.inviteWelcome: KWIIN Mobile Spa comes to you.
contact.copy: WhatsApp is the quickest way to reach Pratana. Tell her which treatment you want, where it will take place, and when suits you.
contact.generalNote: For general questions only. Please book appointments on WhatsApp.
footer.description: Award winning Thai massage as a personal Mobile Spa service at your home, hotel, or office in the Zurich region.
about.medalsAlt: The four medals from the Nordic Nuad Thai Massage Championship 2026: two gold, one silver, one bronze.
about.podiumAlt: Pratana on the top step of the podium, arms raised with her certificate.
about.diplomaAlt: Receiving the first place certificate on the podium.
about.trophyAlt: Pratana holding the trophy alongside the two other winners.
about.groupAlt: Group photograph of everyone taking part in the championship.
about.capTrophy: At the close of the competition
about.championshipCopy: All four medals came from a single day of competition. What you see here is the performance itself: pressure, rhythm and stretch, judged by a specialist panel.
about.perfCaption: The performance she was judged on that day.
about.perfOilAlt: Pratana warming oil in her hands during the competition, before working the back.
about.perfStretchAlt: A signature Thai stretch during the performance, knees at the back and arms drawn open.
about.perfEnergyAlt: Pratana working with open hands above her model's back during the competition.
about.heroLead: In June 2026 Pratana stood on the top step of the podium in Finland. The road there began in Bangkok.
about.laureateAlt: Pratana centre with her trophy, the two other category winners either side with theirs, the Finnish flag behind.
about.laureateMeta: Finland · The winners of the championship

mobile.featuresAria: Details about the KWIIN Mobile Spa service
mobile.faqIntro: Choose your treatment and travel zone. Pratana confirms the appointment personally on WhatsApp.
mobile.faqA1: Pratana comes to you and sets up the massage on site. You receive your treatment at home, in a hotel, or at the office and can keep relaxing afterwards.
mobile.faqA2: Pratana brings a professional massage table, oils, and fresh towels. You only need a little space and a comfortably warm room.
mobile.faqA3: Travel up to 15 km adds CHF 45 to the treatment price. Travel up to 30 km adds CHF 100. You can ask directly about longer distances.
mobile.faqQ4: Which massage is right for me?
mobile.faqA4: Tell Pratana briefly what you need. She helps you choose and adapts the pressure, stretches, and treatment to you.
mobile.faqA5: Choose a treatment, travel zone, and duration. The WhatsApp button prepares your request with the important details.
pricing.addon: Only as an add-on to a treatment. No extra travel fee.

service.sleeping.tagline: Time to slow down and rest.
service.sleeping.description: A gentle massage with slow movements and light pressure. A quiet moment to unwind, relax, and rest.
service.slim.description: A body massage focused on areas with cellulite. The pressure and approach are adapted to you.
office.title: Massage for your team
office.copy: Up to four hours of massage per day at your workplace. We plan individual appointments together to fit your working day.
office.prepare: A quiet, private room, towels, your preferred massage oil, and a timetable are needed. We agree on equipment and who provides what in advance.
office.message: Hello Pratana, I am interested in workplace massage for up to four hours per day. Can we discuss dates, equipment, and a quote?

international.travelCopy: Tell Pratana your preferred country and dates. Together you plan treatments and schedules. Travel, accommodation, and fees are set out in a personal quote.
international.coachingCopy: Practical support for your team, adapted to your business. Choose the topics that help you in your daily work.

Treatment prices are displayed together with the selected travel fee as a total. The 30-minute Crown Serenity and Bata Flow sessions are add-ons only, with no second travel charge.
